Class MessageDispatcher

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am32.network.client.MessageDispatcher
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientMessageVisitor
public class MessageDispatcher extends Object implements ClientMessageVisitor
Incoming network messages are dispatched to the appropriate controller methods.
